subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Many fraud companies _____ (deceive) innocent customers and earn millions of dollars.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deceive"** means to mislead or trick someone into believing something that is not true. (धोखा देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The con artist tried to deceive the elderly couple with a fake investment scheme.
 
 
 
• **"Mislead"** refers to causing someone to have a wrong idea or impression about someone or something. (गुमराह करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The advertisement was designed to mislead customers about the product's benefits.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **mislead.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hamper** (बाधा डालना): To obstruct or impede the movement or progress of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy traffic will hamper our ability to reach the destination on time.
 
 
 
• **Facilitate** (सुविधा प्रदान करना): To make an action or process easier.
 
 
• **Example:** The new software will facilitate the management of inventory.
 
 
 
• **Resolve** (सुलझाना): To find a solution to a problem or conflict.
 
 
• **Example:** They are trying to resolve the dispute through mediation.
